prompts.label: Run tests and fix
prompts.text: Run the tests for what you changed and fix any failures.

prompts.label: Typecheck and lint
prompts.text: Run typecheck and lint, then fix what fails.

prompts.label: Status update
prompts.text: In a few lines: what have you changed so far, what's left, and is anything blocking you?

prompts.label: Review the diff
prompts.text: Review the current uncommitted diff for bugs and anything that breaks our repo rules, before I commit.

prompts.label: Commit (no push)
prompts.text: Commit what you have with a Conventional Commit message. Don't push.

prompts.label: Write PR description
prompts.text: Write the PR description for this branch, following the repo's PR rules.

prompts.label: Pause
prompts.text: Stop at a safe point and wait for me.
